The Beavers were led by fourth-year head coach [[Wayne Tinkle]], and played their home games at [[Gill Coliseum]] in [[Corvallis, Oregon]] as members of the [[Pac-12 Conference men's basketball|Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 16–16, 7–11 in Pac-12 play to finish in tenth place. They defeated [[2017–18 Washington Huskies men's basketball team|Washington]] in the first round of the [[2018 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] before losing in the quarterfinals to [[2017–18 USC Trojans men's basketball team|USC]]. ==Previous season== The [[2016–17 Oregon State Beavers men's basketball team|2016–17 Beavers]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 5–27, 1–17 in the [[2016–17 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12]] to finish last.
